name: geoBoundaries · South Africa
publisher: OCHA ROSEA / South African Municipal Demarcation Board
detail: ADM1, ADM2 and ADM3 boundary files; boundary year represented: 2020.

name: Statistics South Africa
license: Stats SA requires attribution; reprocessed data may not be sold without prior permission.
detail: Bundled Census 2022 municipal extract for all 213 municipalities: population, age, households, dwelling types, water, sanitation and cooking-energy counts. Employment-status, unemployment-rate and industry tables are not included in this extract. Source publication: Stats SA, Census 2022: Provinces at a Glance, released 10 October 2023.

name: Statistics South Africa · Municipal electricity for lighting
license: Stats SA requires attribution; reprocessed data may not be sold without prior permission.
detail: Census municipal fact-sheet values for 2011 and 2022: share of households reporting electricity as their main source for lighting, matched to all 213 municipalities. This is not a measure of grid connection, electricity availability or service reliability.

name: Statistics South Africa · basic service delivery
license: Stats SA requires attribution; reprocessed data may not be sold without prior permission.
detail: Official Census 2011 and 2022 municipal access measures for improved water, sanitation, weekly refuse removal and electricity. The report also gives the percentage of households reporting water interruptions during the previous 12 months. These are dated household survey measures, not live outage monitoring or a general reliability score.

name: Statistics South Africa · Provincial GDP-R
license: Stats SA requires attribution; reprocessed data may not be sold without prior permission.
detail: P0441.2 provincial gross domestic product, contributions, real growth and industry activity for 2014–2024. Current-price values are nominal R million. This source is province-level; municipal GDP is not inferred.

name: Statistics South Africa · Quarterly Labour Force Survey
detail: Official unemployment rate and LU3 estimates for all nine provinces, for Q3 2025, Q2 2026 and Q3 2026. Source: QLFS Q3 2026, Table E, released 10 November 2026. Rates are province-level survey estimates, not municipality-level values.

name: Electoral Commission of South Africa · 2021 councillors
license: See IEC copyright notice and disclaimer
detail: Historical party seat counts aggregated from the IEC elected-councillor list published 20 November 2021, covering all 213 local and metropolitan municipalities. Ward and PR seats are separate; names and identifiers are not retained. Not current council membership after subsequent changes or the 2026 election.

name: Electoral Commission of South Africa · 2026 election results
license: See IEC copyright notice and disclaimer
detail: Official 2026 Local Government Elections reports and seat-calculation downloads are available through the IEC results portal. This application does not yet import a verified 2026 municipal seat dataset. IEC results were declared 9 November 2026; a revote was ordered for one Siyancuma voting district on 10 November 2026.

name: Electoral Commission of South Africa · current ward councillors
license: See IEC copyright notice and disclaimer
detail: IEC's live ward-councillor lookup lists ward representatives and party affiliations. It does not represent the full municipal council, including PR councillors.

name: NASA POWER · Climate
license: NASA POWER data access and attribution terms
detail: Monthly mean 2 m temperature and corrected precipitation climatology for the API's reported 25-year period (currently January 2001–December 2025), queried at a representative point within the selected geography. Gridded point values are not municipal area averages or station observations.

name: World Bank · World Development Indicators
detail: National South Africa GDP in current US dollars, real GDP growth, and agriculture, industry and services value-added shares. These World Development Indicators are country-level measures, not provincial or municipal economic output.

name: National Treasury · Municipal Finance
detail: Live Municipal Money API: income and expenditure, financial position, capital acquisition, grants, repairs and maintenance, UIFW expenditure, and audit-opinion records. Capital Acquisition (v2) provides Section 71 mSCOA expenditure categories. A separate National Treasury and OpenUp register provides named infrastructure-project records. Audit opinions link available reports; the Treasury municipality directory provides official municipal website links. Amounts are reported in South African rand.

name: National Treasury & OpenUp · municipal infrastructure projects
publisher: National Treasury and OpenUp · Municipal Money
license: Municipal Money data terms of use
detail: CivicStats loads municipality-filtered named project records from the public API for the published financial years 2017/2018 and 2019/2020 through 2023/2024. FY 2018/2019 is not present in the source catalogue. Source project classifications are not treated as completion status. This is a distinct dataset from Treasury Capital Acquisition (v2).

name: Auditor-General South Africa
detail: Municipal audit opinions and report links are published through National Treasury's Municipal Money API; AGSA report archive is linked as the publisher.

name: South African Local Government Association
detail: Official publications library and knowledge hub. No public machine-readable dataset API was verified.

name: South African Cities Network
detail: Live public publications feed from the South African Cities Network.
